reviews.review_title: My honest opinion about the game
reviews.review_description:
To be honest, this is a great game with smooth Gorilla Tag movement and mechanics that are easy to learn. There is also active staff who are actually nice and knowledgeable about how players feel, and I think that’s great.

There are a few bugs, but I still had a lot of fun playing the game. The monster, Stella, is also really nice and fast.

One bug I encountered was the hand palms disappearing. However, when I went to a certain spot, they would reappear. The staff also guided me and told me how to fix the bug I encountered, which shows how helpful and supportive they are.

Overall, this is my honest opinion and observation of this Gorilla Tag fangame. I had a great experience playing it, and I think the game has a lot of potential in gaining 
popularity in the gorilla tag fangame community.
Over all fun but so small of a community no one is on but you should play because most likely you found this game when it blows up so there will probably be people on !
I like it but like no ones on sadly😭 but its fun! i recommend
